notes.title: Update on what's going on in my life
notes.notes:
Hey everybody! I hope you have all been doing well! I graduated earlier this year with a BA in Graphic Design and Media Arts. I also interned at a nonprofit organization called the Franco-American Centre and produced some 3D animated videos for them! Check them out!

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=o5vGB4xttJ0

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=UyRFaS7H2wQ

As far as Coffee Run goes, I think I am going to move on to other projects (not enough people seemed interested in figuring out the storyline behind the game or interested in updates for the game in general), so yeah. If, all of a sudden, there is a large amount of demand for me updating the game, or if I get some really interesting ideas for a new update, then I will. But that doesn't seem to be the case right now. 

I developed a brand for myself called Rodey Designs. You can check out my website at www.geocities.ws/andrewstestingwebsite/rodeydesigns to see all my latest 3D creations. I know, I should invest in a custom domain, and I probably will soon! 

Have a happy holiday season, everyone. 

-Andrew

notes.title: Update 2.17
notes.notes:
Hello my fellow coffee drinkers, I have fixed the audio bugs that were present in version 2.16! 

-Andrew Rodenhiser

notes.title: Update 2.16
notes.notes:
Hello everyone!

I made a small update to the color scheme [I changed the menu colors up as an experiment; let me know if the new scheme suits the theme of the game] and also, I modified the Coffee Run logo! Additionally, some of you commented on how the hit-boxes of the coins weren't completely centered, so I fixed those! Furthermore, I made the Zippity Doo Da powerups spawn less often because I felt there were too many of them.

There's currently a little bug affecting some of the sounds [particularly the click noises on the menu and a bit of Joe's dialogue]. I'll get to fixing it as soon as I can. Other than that, the game runs just fine.

-Andrew Rodenhiser

notes.title: Update 2.15!
notes.notes:
Hi everyone,

Just a little update on the main menu of the game! You can now switch songs instantly [without having to go to another scene and then come back] by pressing an extra button called "Switch Music"! Special thanks to my friend who helped me fix this bug! 

More fixes coming soon! I have received some input on how the game could be improved and I greatly appreciate those suggestions! 

-Andrew R.

notes.title: Version 2 of COFFEE RUN is released :)
notes.notes:
Hello everyone, thank you so much for your support. Version 2 of Coffee Run has been released. I guarantee that it is MUCH BETTER than Version 1, in terms of graphics, texturing, animation, game performance, bug fixes, as well as some additional features that were not in the first game [dialogue, in-game instructions, option to use the arrow keys, a hidden storyline, straight-line run]. 
Bear in mind there are some bugs which I will fix ASAP, but please keep in mind that I am simultaneously taking college courses, so it could take a few more months. 
I really hope that you guys enjoy this update. I started making these enhancements to Coffee Run less than a month after the game's initial release. I really appreciate the feedback from you guys, regardless if it is positive or negative. Really, I do. Your feedback allows me to grow as a video game designer. My goal is to bring joy and laughter to the gaming community. I created Coffee Run with that goal in mind. 

NEW FEATURES

-Brand new splash screen "Made with Unity". It's blueeeeee....ooooooh!
-Joe Cappuccino can speak.
-Music selection [the player can choose between the classic whistling, the new "Technowhim" song, or no music at all]
-Running selection screen [the player can choose between running in a diagonal pattern or in a straight line]
-A loading screen so the player doesn't fret that the game crashed.
-There are now iced coffees and styrafoam coffee cups, in addition to mugs.
-Brand new look to the coins; they ascend to the heavens when collected.
-The player can pause the game by pressing P. This reveals the Options and Instructions buttons. 
-The player can quit the game anytime [except on the game over screen] by hitting the Escape key.
-A 3D Coffee Shop [currently has three Powerups from the first game along with donuts that grant the player extra lives from the start of each run from that point on]. More items coming soon!

Known bugs (in Version 2.0.1)

-When choosing music for the gameplay [from the pop-up menu], players can select a song, however, the song selection button they choose will play, even if they select another song. This concept applies until the player returns to the main menu later [can select an alternative song if players hit the Play Button/Shop Button and then hit backspace] 

-When hitting the backspace key from the Shop, player returns to the gameplay world [even if they went to the shop from the menu]. 

-Overlapping text "MORE ITEMS COMING SOON!" overlaps with loading screen [only applies to when in the shop]. 

-The Options Button can only be clicked when the player mouses over to the top left corner of the button [when it is highlighted]. 


I know you guys want a Leaderboard feature, and that will come in a later update. I will update the game more often from this point on and will work on adding that feature. There will be a series of small updates coming up within a matter of weeks [how soon depends on my schedule]. 

Enjoy Version 2.0.1! Please feel free to point out any more bugs that are not listed here! I appreciate constructive criticism.

-Andrew Rodenhiser

notes.title: Coffee Run Update 2.0 Taken Tremendous Strides!!
notes.notes:
Hello everyone, this is Andrew Rodenhiser updating you on the next version of Coffee Run! :) 

For the past few months, I have been fixating intensely on improving the game's graphics, overall gameplay, performance, and features. 

Let me just say that this next update will knock Version 1 right out of the park. Guaranteed. Version 1 was almost like a joke with its utterly simple graphics, lazy texturing, lags, bugs, bizarre audio, and mundane repetition. 

My number one goal in life right now is to transform this glitchy and poorly designed game into a polished and dynamic gaming experience that will entertain players for hours on end. I will not rest for an instant until this game matches the positive description of the sarcastic comments left on Version 1. 

The game will not be released until it is tested thoroughly on multiple devices (with some devices older than others). I am starting my online college-work a few weeks before my term officially begins so that I can work on the game at the same pace as I was during my summer break. 

I would say that version 2.0 will be released (AT THE EARLIEST) late 2018 or (AT THE LATEST) mid-2019. 

In the update, there will be a new design for the Cappuccino coins and a wider variety of coffees to collect (i.e. not just limited to mugs). There will also be more types of powerups and items to purchase using coins in a 3D Coffee Shop. One factor that I hope will raise the game's reviews/ratings is that I have incorporated...believe it or not, story elements. Additionally, yours truly will be the voice of Joe Cappuccino. ;) I can't wait to see how this all turns out. 

Thus far, my friends and family are blown away by the massive improvements the game has undergone. There's still some room for improvement, which I am more than glad to provide, so please hang in there, guys. 

Here are some images of what will be coming up in the update. It is quite possible that by the time the update is released, the graphics will be even better and more detailed than what is shown below. As always, stay tuned!

-Andrew Rodenhiser

notes.title: Now available for Mac PLUS News Update
notes.notes:
Hi everybody, no changes to Coffee Run are published...yet. However, the game is now available on Mac! 

I have already made some changes to the game (not available on Steam yet) and followed the community's advice on how to make Coffee Run perform, look, sound, and play better. 

Honestly, there most likely won't be an update until sometime in the summer BECAUSE I don't want you guys to be disappointed with the outcome. Time is everything. I need lots of time to make the game truly remarkable. 

I have accomplished the following so far:

-There is an option for Joe to run in a straight line that can be made right after clicking the Play button

-Already have changed the music but am currently working on a way to choose either the annoying whistling (which you guys love SOOOOO much) or the new and improved tune

-The pause/options buttons are no longer visible on the side of the screen. They will be accessed by pressing P (for pause) or Esc. 

-Instructions are enhanced (i.e. much more descriptive) and will be readable from an extra button when you press P or Esc.

-Spawning of coffee cups is significantly improved. Remember when you would start the game and there was no coffee nearby? That will be a rare event.

-Donuts now provide you with an extra life

-Donut colliders have been improved (i.e. you don't need to be an inch away from the donut in order to pick it up)

-Cars are no longer floating and are no longer "in reverse"

-The infamous LAG has been fixed (loading the level)!!!


One of the huge things I need to fix is the graphics. I admit that I rushed the game in terms of level design. I will not release the update until the graphics are clean, polished, more detailed, and more spiffy. 

The long wait will be worth it. For now, the game is a joke (which is awesome but I want to make it more respectable). Once the update arrives, you guys are going to be impressed. 

Until then, have fun playing Coffee Run as it is! (LOL) 

-Andrew Rodenhiser

notes.title: News update on Coffee Run v2
notes.notes:
Since some people (myself included) don't want the diagonal running feature to be removed, I decided to make a compromise. The upcoming Coffee Run update will allow the player to choose the style of running they want before getting transported to the level. They will be able to choose between the classic Diagonal running option and the Straight Line running option (running forward). Of course, with the Straight Line running option, Joe can still switch lanes in the road but he just runs forward after switching.  

Also, the music has changed. No annoying whistling, none of that. The music in the next release will sound like the one in the game trailer except without the whistling. 

In addition, there is not going to be a Pause button as the user will be able to pause the game by either pressing 'P' on their keyboard or 'Escape". Only when paused will the user be able to see the Options button. 

The range of coffee cups spawning has been fixed so now there shouldn't be as many instances in which there are no Coffee Cups towards the beginning of the run. Also, the powerup spawning has been fixed as well as the cars coming out of bushes.

Keep in mind that the fixes are not available yet. I really want to reconstruct the game world and test the game THOROUGHLY before releasing the update. I estimate that I'll be able to release Coffee Run version 2 within the next few months. Possibly four or five. My goal is to not disappoint you guys, so I'll need lots of time to reconstruct Coffee Run. 

Finally, if anybody has any ideas for Coffee Run version 2, please feel free to comment below on this announcement. I'm open to all of your ideas. 

Thank you for all your support and have a Happy Thanksgiving!

-Andrew Rodenhiser (BlenderBender)

notes.title: I apologize for all the bugs, an update is currently in the making
notes.notes:
Hey guys, I know there have been several complaints about Coffee Run's performance and it seems that very few people can tolerate the music, so I will be working on fixing up the game very soon. Just to clarify, these are the bugs which I will try my hardest to fix in the next update.

1. When clicking Play on the main menu, the game appears to crash but in reality, it is loading (takes about 15-20 seconds to render the level). If the actual loading time cannot be reduced, then I will put in a loading screen. So far, everybody has commented about this one.

2. The fact that Joe Cappuccino runs diagonally forward was actually unintended. I actually thought this bug would bring a unique kind of gameplay, but a fair amount of people have complained about this, so nevertheless, I will straighten the direction in which Joe runs. 

3. I will fix the spawning of the coffee cups (sometimes they spawn kind of far away from the starting point). For now, when the coffee cups aren't in plain sight right away, you can press R to reload the level until the coffee cups are close enough. :)

4. I shall ensure that no more cars will come out of bushes. Initially, I thought this was funny and that people would get a kick out of it, but it turns out that you guys didn't like that, so that will be fixed. 

In addition, I will work on remodeling the character, the city, and all the other backgrounds. Also, get ready for this. I WILL change the music. :) 

One more important note- the powerups that you purchase for 500 coins appear after you run for a little bit (they should pop up somewhere down the road). I will ensure that they spawn closer to the starting point in the update. 

Thanks for all your honest and hilariously sarcastic reviews! The game will get better, I promise!

-Andrew Rodenhiser (BlenderBender)
